blocks.en: The Cauchy-Kovalevskaya Theorem
blocks.zh: Cauchy-Kovalevskaya 定理
blocks.label: sec:cauchy-kovalevskaya

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: The theorem of Cauchy and Kovalevskaya quite generally asserts the local existence of solutions to a system of partial differential equations with initial conditions on a noncharacteristic surface. The coefficients in the equations, the initial data and the surface on which they are prescribed are required to be analytic. This is a severe restriction which, in general, cannot be removed. Moreover, we shall see that the theorem does not distinguish between well-posed and ill-posed problems; it covers situations where a small change in the data leads to a large change in the solution. For these reasons, the theorem has little practical importance. Historically, however, it is the first existence theorem for a general class of PDEs and it is one of very few such theorems which can be proved without the tools of functional analysis.
blocks.zh: Cauchy 和 Kovalevskaya 的定理相当一般地断言, 在非特征曲面上给定初始条件的偏微分方程组存在局部解. 它要求方程中的系数, 初始数据以及施加这些数据的曲面都是解析的. 这是一个严格限制, 一般不能去掉. 此外, 我们将看到, 这一定理并不区分适定问题与不适定问题; 它也涵盖数据的微小改变导致解发生很大改变的情形. 由于这些原因, 这一定理的实际重要性不大. 然而, 从历史上看, 它是关于一般一类偏微分方程的第一个存在性定理, 也是极少数不借助泛函分析工具就能证明的此类定理之一.

blocks.en: With these preliminaries we are ready to define real analytic functions.
blocks.zh: 有了这些准备, 就可以定义实解析函数.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.label: def:real-analytic-function

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points
visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Vector- or matrix-valued functions will be called analytic if their components are analytic. The symbol $C^\omega(\Omega)$ is used to denote the class of functions analytic in $\Omega$, whereas $C^\infty(\Omega)$ denotes functions which have derivatives of all orders. Obviously $C^\omega(\Omega)\subset C^\infty(\Omega)$. Like holomorphic functions of a single complex variable, analytic functions have a unique continuation property.
blocks.zh: 若向量值或矩阵值函数的各分量都解析, 就称该函数解析. 用符号 $C^\omega(\Omega)$ 表示在 $\Omega$ 内解析的函数类, 而 $C^\infty(\Omega)$ 表示具有各阶导数的函数. 显然 $C^\omega(\Omega)\subset C^\infty(\Omega)$. 同单复变全纯函数一样, 解析函数具有唯一延拓性质.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Let $\Omega$ be a domain (i.e., an open connected set), and let $f$ and $g$ be analytic in $\Omega$. If, for some point $\bm{x}_0\in\Omega$, we have $D^\alpha f(\bm{x}_0)=D^\alpha g(\bm{x}_0)$ for every $\alpha$, then $f=g$ in $\Omega$.
blocks.zh: 设 $\Omega$ 为区域 (即连通开集), $f$ 和 $g$ 在 $\Omega$ 内解析. 如果存在某点 $\bm{x}_0\in\Omega$, 使每个 $\alpha$ 都满足 $D^\alpha f(\bm{x}_0)=D^\alpha g(\bm{x}_0)$, 则在 $\Omega$ 内有 $f=g$.
blocks.label: thm:real-analytic-unique-continuation

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points
visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: If $f$ is analytic at a point $\bm{y}$, then the derivatives of $f$ satisfy a bound of the form \eqref{eq:power-series-factorial-derivative-bound} in some neighborhood of $\bm{y}$. It turns out that this property characterizes real analytic functions.
blocks.zh: 如果 $f$ 在点 $\bm{y}$ 处解析, 那么 $f$ 的导数在 $\bm{y}$ 的某个邻域内满足形如 \eqref{eq:power-series-factorial-derivative-bound} 的界. 这一性质实际上刻画了实解析函数.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.label: def:factorial-derivative-class

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: The following equivalence holds.
blocks.zh: 有如下等价关系.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Let $\Omega$ be an open set and let $f\in C^\infty(\Omega)$. Then $f\in C^\omega(\Omega)$ if and only if the following holds: For every compact set $S\subset\Omega$ there exist positive numbers $M$ and $r$ with $f\in C_{M,r}(\bm{y})$ for every $\bm{y}\in S$.
blocks.zh: 设 $\Omega$ 为开集, $f\in C^\infty(\Omega)$. 那么 $f\in C^\omega(\Omega)$ 当且仅当以下条件成立: 对每个紧集 $S\subset\Omega$, 都存在正数 $M$ 和 $r$, 使每个 $\bm{y}\in S$ 都有 $f\in C_{M,r}(\bm{y})$.
blocks.label: thm:factorial-bound-analytic-equivalence

blocks.en: The characterization of real analytic functions as restrictions of complex differentiable functions allows a simple proof of the implicit function theorem for real analytic functions.
blocks.zh: 将实解析函数刻画为复可微函数的限制, 就能简单地证明实解析函数的隐函数定理.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.label: thm:real-analytic-implicit-function

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: By extending $\bm{x}$ and $\bm{y}$ to $\mathbb{C}^n$, the theorem is reduced to the implicit function theorem for differentiable functions, a generalization of Theorem~\ref{thm:implicit-function}.
blocks.zh: 将 $\bm{x}$ 和 $\bm{y}$ 延拓到 $\mathbb{C}^n$, 这一定理就归结为可微函数的隐函数定理, 即 Theorem~\ref{thm:implicit-function} 的推广.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: The characterization of analytic functions as differentiable functions of complex variables also implies that the composite of two analytic functions is analytic.
blocks.zh: 将解析函数刻画为复变量的可微函数, 还意味着两个解析函数的复合也是解析的.

blocks.en: Majorization
blocks.zh: 优控
blocks.label: subsec:majorization

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: The proof of the Cauchy-Kovalevskaya theorem uses the method of majorization, which consists of comparing analytic functions with other functions which have larger Taylor coefficients, but can be given explicitly. We make the following definition.
blocks.zh: Cauchy-Kovalevskaya 定理的证明使用优控方法, 即将解析函数与具有更大 Taylor 系数, 但可以显式给出的其他函数作比较. 作如下定义.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Let $f$, $F$ be real analytic functions defined in a neighborhood of the origin of $\mathbb{R}^n$. Then we say that $f$ is \textbf{majorized} by $F$, $f\preceq F$ if $|D^\alpha f(\bm{0})|\leq D^\alpha F(\bm{0})$ for every $\alpha$.
blocks.zh: 设 $f$, $F$ 为定义在 $\mathbb{R}^n$ 原点的某个邻域内的实解析函数. 如果对每个 $\alpha$ 都有 $|D^\alpha f(\bm{0})|\leq D^\alpha F(\bm{0})$, 则称 $f$ \textbf{受} $F$ \textbf{优控}, 记作 $f\preceq F$.
blocks.label: def:analytic-majorization

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.label: ex:rational-analytic-majorant

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: We need the following result concerning composite functions.
blocks.zh: 需要以下关于复合函数的结果.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Let $\bm{f}$, $\bm{F}$ be vector-valued real analytic functions from a neighborhood of the origin in $\mathbb{R}^n$ into $\mathbb{R}^m$ such that $\bm{f}(\bm{0})=\bm{F}(\bm{0})=0$. Let $g$, $G$ be real analytic functions from a neighborhood of the origin in $\mathbb{R}^m$ into $\mathbb{R}$. Assume that $f_i\preceq F_i$ for $i=1,\ldots,m$ and $g\preceq G$. Then $g\circ\bm{f}\preceq G\circ\bm{F}$.
blocks.zh: 设 $\bm{f}$, $\bm{F}$ 为从 $\mathbb{R}^n$ 原点的某个邻域映入 $\mathbb{R}^m$ 的向量值实解析函数, 满足 $\bm{f}(\bm{0})=\bm{F}(\bm{0})=0$. 设 $g$, $G$ 为从 $\mathbb{R}^m$ 原点的某个邻域映入 $\mathbb{R}$ 的实解析函数. 假设对 $i=1,\ldots,m$ 有 $f_i\preceq F_i$, 并且 $g\preceq G$. 那么 $g\circ\bm{f}\preceq G\circ\bm{F}$.
blocks.label: thm:majorization-under-composition

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: The proof follows by noting that all derivatives of $g\circ\bm{f}$ can be expressed as polynomials involving derivatives of $g$ and $\bm{f}$. All these polynomials have positive coefficients. Hence they can be estimated by the corresponding polynomials involving derivatives of $G$ and $\bm{F}$.
blocks.zh: 注意到 $g\circ\bm{f}$ 的所有导数都可表示为含有 $g$ 和 $\bm{f}$ 的导数的多项式, 就得到证明. 这些多项式的系数都为正. 因而可以用含有 $G$ 和 $\bm{F}$ 的导数的对应多项式来估计它们.
